panel_tier_formulas.parquet: Frozen RDKit formula evidence for the 1,875,318 unique public panel tier rows; reused from the pinned public-source benchmark preparation.
replay_public_priors.py: Standalone CPU-only reproduction of the cached annotation-only public panel benchmark; no fitting, GPU or external input needed; Apache-2.0.
SOURCE_CHECK_20261019.md: Primary-source provenance note, corrected on 2026-10-20 for LOTUS frozen 2026-04-13 / Zenodo 19360665 / CC BY 4.0; retains conservative NPAtlas terms.
prior_rule_per_query.parquet: All 250 molecules x 5 fixed annotation-only ranking rules, including absent truths as zero. Analytical exact-tie expected reciprocal ranks.
panel_logits.npz: 250 molecule-level A+B/fold-safe logit vectors, each 10,226 bits, plus scorer identity keys. Original public notebook query preprocessing; no spectra.
gate_diagnostics.csv: Exact-identity public panel gate diagnostics for the fixed mixtures, including raw pool margin and original 150/600 thresholds; development simulation, not full-pipeline validation.
pubchem_signals.parquet: 1,939,476 original candidate rows: frozen 2026-04-13 LOTUS reference counts/NP bit, any-NP flag and float32 v10 prior; all unrelated annotations remain unchanged.
aligned_public_priors.py: Lightweight memory-map, log1p-precision and PubChemLite row-alignment consumer helpers; Apache-2.0.
pubchemlite_annotations.parquet: 385,760 original PubChemLite rows and original representative tier lookup; refreshed LOTUS membership bit and raw-key LOTUS reference counts, with original dtypes and row order.
PANEL_REPLAY_PUBLIC.json: Public nextnb panel replay report, wrapper lineage and notebook summary. Different query protocol from historical pool-window evaluations.
panel_fpnet_per_molecule.csv: Per-molecule reciprocal rank, top identity, shortlist and gate diagnostics for all predeclared fold-safe mixtures. Missing-candidate molecules are padded to zero during summarization.
README.md: Current dataset instructions, this release card, source terms and clearly labelled previous-version documentation.
prior_replay.json: Protocol, fixed weights, precision, denominator and summary of the reproducible annotation-only panel experiment.
panel_metric_identities.parquet: Original immutable 49,319-row sparse exact identity/pool cache. For refreshed fixed-arm replay, concatenate lotus_replay_identity_additions.parquet; candidate_row is the unique positional join key.
MANIFEST_20261019.json: Historical inventory of an earlier source snapshot. Use CHANGED_FILES.json for exact overlay sizes, SHA-256 and previous hashes; keep all unlisted baseline files.
identity_audit.json: Per-query audit of exact visited scorer identities, old nonempty-key disagreements and pool-membership corrections; reused from the completed public replay.
VALIDATION_20261019.json: Historical 2026-10-19 validation with an explicit pointer to the current LOTUS refresh validation.
panel_same_formula.parquet: One exact-formula membership flag per public panel molecule/tier-row pair.
panel.parquet: 250 public labelled natural-product panel identities, masses and query-summary metadata, copied byte-identically from the public panel benchmark; no spectra.
summarize_panel_fpnet.py: Reproduce cached per-query MRR/top-1 and paired 20,000-molecule-bootstrap intervals without inference or other mounted datasets; Apache-2.0.
panel_fpnet_scores.parquet: 1,939,476 source-aligned public candidate rows: A+B and fold-safe full and ECFP4 partial fingerprint scores; float32 with NaN parse failures; original candidate_row and tier_row preserved.
panel_truth_formula.parquet: Public answer formulas for all 250 labelled panel molecules, derived from the existing main candidate table; evaluation only.
prior_rule_summary.csv: Five annotation-only exact-formula rules, each with the same 250-molecule denominator; MRR@25 and delta from documentation alone.
FILE_DESCRIPTIONS.json: Descriptions of every staged file, including this index.
MANIFEST_20261019_2.json: Historical additive inventory of the 2026-10-19 panel difficulty and folds snapshot; current changed-file integrity is in CHANGED_FILES.json.
VALIDATION_20261020.json: LOTUS refresh checks: exact old reconstructions, unchanged schemas/order/unrelated columns, dependent replays, unchanged-ranking evidence, and staged-byte scan.
LOTUS_REFRESH.json: Frozen LOTUS 2026-04-13 provenance, per-column changes, old/new replay results, paired refresh intervals, unchanged-result proofs and limitations.
CHANGED_FILES.json: Changed-file overlay receipt: relative file names, byte sizes, SHA-256 and previous SHA-256; excludes its own recursive hash.
CARD_CHANGES.md: Exact old-to-new edit instructions for the existing README and technical notes; apply separately after review.
panel_difficulty.parquet: 250 panel molecules in original order; original ambiguity/reference/raw-score columns, refreshed scorer-alias LOTUS NPClassifier labels and four v10 prior tied-rank columns.
lotus_replay_identity_additions.parquet: Additional exact identities/pool flags visited after the LOTUS prior refresh; original sparse identity schema, sorted by candidate_row, disjoint from the unchanged original cache. Exact immutable tier SMILES, pinned public scorer and stored pool keys; no inferred connectivity fallback.
